method.primary_window: actual target ACK +0.30s through first zero ACK -0.03s
method.limitations: Measured optical-coordinate body twist; not individual wheel RPM, not guaranteed physical speed scale. One surviving observation is not repeatability evidence.

summary.higher_pwm_window_caveat: Minimum target duration for primary window is0.30+0.03+0.25=0.58s. Total1.2s includes warmup. Higher yaw may trigger20deg cut before0.58s; do not weaken motion/pose/stop gates to obtain longer samples.
retest_needed_before_complete_curve: 70/180 and70/200: only one accepted attempt each
